approvals.quote: I always trust our own projects because the only two people working on them are you and I.
approvals.approving: Answering Claude Code's folder-trust dialog Yes for THIS folder only, on a session lane-restart relaunched: the dialog must show 'Accessing workspace:', the exact line 'C:\Projects\baracuda' followed by a blank row (a wrapped or longer path never matches), and 'Yes, I trust this folder'. The default selection is 'No, exit', so the keys are Down then Enter. One record per lane folder; no prefix, no wildcard.
